domain_restrictions: n is an integer greater than 1
j runs over integers from 1 to n-1
for every j in 1..n-1, the index n-j is a positive integer (so H_{n-j} is defined)
H_n and H_{n-j} denote harmonic numbers (so the underlying sums defining them have no zero denominators)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every integer n greater than 1, the sum over integers j with 1 <= j <= n-1 of H_{n-j} equals n times (H_n minus 1).
quantifier_order: for all integers n with n > 1

variables.name: j
variables.role: summation index within the left-hand side sum

statement_nl: For every integer n > 1, sum_{j=1}^{n-1} H_{n-j} = n*(H_n - 1).
